preconditions.description: The input num must be an integer.
The input num must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: Removing all dashes from the output yields the original number as a string.

postconditions.expression: all(not (int(s[i]) % 2 == 1 and int(s[i+1]) % 2 == 1) for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i+1] != '-' for s in [return_value])
postconditions.description: No two consecutive digits in the output are both odd numbers.

postconditions.expression: all((s[i] == '-' and int(s[i-1]) % 2 == 1 and int(s[i+1]) % 2 == 1) or (s[i] != '-' and not (int(s[i-1]) % 2 == 1 and int(s[i+1]) % 2 == 1)) for i in range(1, len(s)-1) for s in [return_value] if s[i] == '-')
postconditions.description: Every dash in the output is placed exactly between two odd digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value.count('-') == sum(1 for i in range(len(str(num))-1) if int(str(num)[i]) % 2 == 1 and int(str(num)[i+1]) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: The number of dashes equals the number of adjacent odd digit pairs in the original number.
